_doc: Harbor Place, Bar Harbor: the whole fixed waterfront from the whale-watch slip head to the inlet wall, built on piles (Matt 31 Oct: "the whole of Harbor Place is also built on pilings (there is no actual ground around at all)"). Generated by tools/assets/harbor_place/dock_json.py from layout.json (docs/harbor-place.md items 1 and 4). Coordinates are LEVEL metres (x east, z south): each platform has its own at/heading, the walls are paths in level metres with at [0,0]. Floats and gangways are NOT here: they stay in levels/downeast/docks.json bar_harbor_whale_watch, hinged on this deck at +3.3. The only ground is the beach between the timber deck and Stewman's; everything under these decks is water and mud (World cuts the terrain).

frame.note: the slip-head frame every platform shares: local +z toward the water, local +x to the west

platforms._doc: A: the apron, slip head (out) and the dinghy channel (port, east). The safety fence of the slip photo along both. ww_r1 and ww_r2 hinge on its out edge.
A: the deck Harbor Place stands on (World's building, base +3.3). East end on the town pier fill; west face over the beach (stbd), no fence (the building wall is there).
B: the street-level deck behind the building, east half, its back on the West Street retaining wall.
B: west half, shallower because West Street bends north; its west end looks over the inlet (fence).
C: the open-board deck at ww_w's head; ww_rk (kayak ramp) and ww_k along its north edge. Rail on the slip (out) and ww_w (stbd) sides.
C: its west lobe over the beach, rail on the open sides.

walls._doc: The granite wall at the head of the inlet, West Street's retaining wall (USA18); face north to the beach. Top +6.0 (street), foot +1.0.
The poured retaining wall under the street deck (B), West Street's edge; face north. B bears on its top; foot on the +1.5 beach.
